headline: Continued hearings for Robert C. Hardy and Pauline Cabrila; approved consolidating the two matters.
summary: Members consolidated the Robert C. Hardy and Pauline Cabrila matters and continued their hearings. Nick Palmer was appointed chairman pro tempore after a Zoom feed issue. Members tabled a discussion on chairperson voting on continuances.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 24, 2026 meeting; all in favor, none opposed.
Approved consolidating the Robert C. Hardy and Pauline Cabrila matters; all in favor, none opposed.
Approved appointing Nick Palmer as chairman pro tempore; all in favor, none opposed.
Continued the Robert C. Hardy and Pauline Cabrila hearings; all in favor, none opposed.

Approved, as amended, holding a special session within 5 days of receiving City reports, or hearing them on the normal meeting date if they do not arrive within 5 business days; all in favor, none opposed.
Tabled the discussion on chairperson voting on continuances going forward; all in favor, none opposed.
Approved September 23, 2026 as the next meeting date; all in favor, none opposed.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION TO APPROVE the minutes of the June 24, 2026 meeting by Anthony Lozier, Seconded by Kimberly Gendron. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.
Motion to Consolidate the two matters on the agenda by Cristina Costa, Seconded by Sue Pyzynski. All in favor, none opposed, motion carries.
There was an issue with our zoom feed and a Motion to Appoint Nick Palmer as chairman pro tempore was brought forward by Sue Pyzynski and seconded by Kimberly Gendron. All in favor, none opposed.
There was another Motion for Continuance of the hearings by Nick Palmer and seconded by Kimberly Gendron. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.

Motion to Conduct a special session within 5 days of receiving reports from the City. An amended Motion was read that if the reports do not come within 5 business days within our regularly scheduled meeting, we’ll hear them on our normal date by Nick Palmer which was seconded by Sue Pyzynski. All in favor, none opposed. Motion carries.
Motion to Table the Discussion on Chairperson voting on continuances going forward which was seconded by Cristina. All in favor, none opposed. Motion caries.
Motion to Adopt September 23, 2026 as our next meeting date by Anthony Lozier, seconded by Nick Palmer, all in favor none opposed.

FAIR RENT COMMISSION 
August 26, 2026 at 6:00 PM  
Bristol City Hall 
111 N. Main Street, Bristol, CT 
MINUTES 
 NAME PRESENT ABSENT 
COMMISSIONERS Anthony Lozier (T) – Chairman    
 Brian Brady (H) X  
 Adam Brothwell (H)  X 
 Bryan Brown (L)  X 
 Cristina Costa (T) X  
 Susan Pyzynski (H) X  
 Debra Schur (L) X  
 Nick Palmer (L) X  
 Kimberly Gendron (T) Alternate X  
 Kimberly Ploszaj (H) Alternate X  
    
COUNCIL LIASION Erick Rosengren  X 
    
STAFF Attorney Jonathan Donovan, Asst. Corp. 
Counsel 
X  
 Maria Theam, Corporation Counsel’s Office X  
Note:  H (Homeowner Representative) L (Landlord Representative) T (Tenant Representative) 
1. Call To Order 
The meeting was called to order at 6:03 p.m. 
2. Introduction of Commissioners 
The commissioners introduced themselves. 
3. Seating of Alternates 
No alternates were seated for this meeting. 
4. Discussion and Approval of minutes of June 24, 2026 and take any action as necessary. 
MOTION TO APPROVE the minutes of the June 24, 2026 meeting by Anthony Lozier, Seconded 
by Kimberly Gendron.  All in favor, none opposed.  Motion carries.
5. Vote on the Continuance of the hearings in the matters of: 
a. Robert C. Hardy 
b. Pauline Cabrila 
 
Motion to Consolidate the two matters on the agenda by Cristina Costa, Seconded by Sue Pyzynski.  All 
in favor, none opposed, motion carries.   
 
Motion to Continue the cases to next month by Cristina Costa, Seconded by Kimberly Gendron.  
Discussion was had by the commission.   
 
There was an issue with our zoom feed and a Motion to Appoint Nick Palmer as chairman pro tempore 
was brought forward by Sue Pyzynski and seconded by Kimberly Gendron.  All in favor, none opposed.   
 
There was another Motion for Continuance of the hearings by Nick Palmer and seconded by Kimberly 
Gendron.  All in favor, none opposed.  Motion carries.   
 
Motion to Conduct a special session within 5 days of receiving reports from the City.  An amended 
Motion was read that if the reports do not come within 5 business days within our regularly scheduled 
meeting, we’ll hear them on our normal date by Nick Palmer which was seconded by Sue Pyzynski.  All in 
favor, none opposed.   Motion carries.   
 
6. Discussion by Commissioners of old business and take any action as necessary. 
None. 
 
7. Discussion by Commissioners of new business and take any action as necessary. 
Motion to Table the Discussion on Chairperson voting on continuances going forward which was 
seconded by Cristina.  All in favor, none opposed.  Motion caries.   
 
8. Discussion by Commissioners of meeting dates and agendas and take any action as necessary. 
a. Next Meeting: September 23, 2026 at 6:00 pm, City Hall 
 
Motion to Adopt September 23, 2026 as our next meeting date by Anthony Lozier, 
seconded by Nick Palmer, all in favor none opposed.   
 
9. Public Participation 
Dawn S. discussed the continuance of the complaints.  Mr. Eric Tessman appeared with his 
father, inquired about filing a fair rent complaint.   
 
10. Adjournment 
Motion to Adjourn by Anthony Lozier at 6:33 pm and seconded by Kimberly Ploszaj.  All in favor, 
none opposed. Motion carries and meeting was adjourned.   
Respectfully Submitted, 
Maria Theam, recording secretary
